description.value: Sunder the earth beneath your feet with your ki, harming creatures caught in its path. Grounded creatures within a 15 foot line take an amount of earth damage equal to 1d8 per monk level and suffer the Immobilized status effect for 1 round. A successful Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of your monk level + your Constitution modifier) halves this damage and negates the status effect.
